Title: 496436-2026: France – Construction work for art and culture buildings – Works for the rehabilitation of the Conservatoire de musique and the Auditorium of Annemasse - Lots 03, 07, 08, 17, 18, 19
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Refurbishment of a conservatory and auditorium (large cultural/music building) is thematically very relevant for sbp. The location in France (outside DACH) and lot-wise award with lump-sum prices slightly reduce the priority.
titel: Construction works for the refurbishment of the music conservatory and auditorium of Annemasse – Lots 03, 07, 08, 17, 18, 19
kurzbeschreibung: Refurbishment of a conservatory and auditorium with several structural and fit-out lots.
umfang: Refurbishment of a music conservatory and auditorium in several separate lots; the works tendered are structural works and external works, interior carpentry, plastering and ceiling works, gutting and demolition, acoustic curtains and painting works. Start of execution 01.10.2026, planned construction period per lot 17 months. No information on GFA, capacities, spans or structural parameters.
leistungen: Construction works in 6 lots: Lot 03 structural works and external works, Lot 07 interior joinery works, Lot 08 plastering and ceiling works, Lot 17 gutting and demolition, Lot 18 acoustic curtains, Lot 19 painting works.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• This concerns pure construction execution in fit-out and structural lots, not planning or structural design services.
• Although the project is a cultural building, there are no indications of complex structural concepts, large spans or special structures.
• No explicit requirements for structural design, civil engineering or planning-related references.
• Strategically of only low relevance for sbp, as there is no apparent entry opportunity via design or special structures.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs are stated in the notice. Essential information such as GFA, scope of the overall project, structural share, level of technical fit-out and costs per lot is missing for a reliable estimate. It is a refurbishment of a cultural building with 6 tendered fit-out and structural lots over 17 months; a rough overall estimate would be conceivable, but is not sufficiently reliable based on the notice.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee stated. As only construction works are being tendered and no design services for structures or civil engineering are included, an sbp fee cannot be derived from the notice.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Suitability criteria according to the procurement documents; no specific reference requirements are stated in the notice itself.
zuschlagskriterien: Price 40%, technical quality 55%, environmental performance during execution 5%; sub-criteria of technical quality: human resources and adherence to deadlines 10%, methodology and site organisation 20%, waste and emissions management 15%, cultural approach 10%.
auftraggeber: Annemasse les Voirons Agglomération, 11 Avenue Emile Zola, 74100 Annemasse, France, Contact: DOUBLET Gabriel, E-mail: commande-publique@annemasse-agglo.fr, Website: https://www.annemasse-agglo.fr/partenaires-et-pros/marches-publics; additional contracting authority: Ville d'Annemasse, 74100 Annemasse, France, E-mail: commande-publique@annemasse-agglo.fr
notes: Multi-lot tender with a maximum of 6 lots per bidder and a maximum of 6 awards per bidder. Electronic submission of tenders required, language French. No variants permitted. Prices revisable. Social, cultural and environmental conditions for execution according to the specifications. Despite being labelled as a competition, the notice is in substance a construction works tender.
